searchText: BTW <@!420501213327392770> recently made me realize another argument against gas (or oil) being unobservable Basically, resource consumption needs to be observable in the context of optimistic rollup fraud proofs I believe something like https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-2733 would give back observability of gas at a tx level yeah, OR relying on metatransactions could work As long as there is access to the total gas consumed then whatever works. And for context we’ll need total gas used to rate limit the OR chain
